signal: $220M Series C plus debt. Hiring Manager, Reductions & Payor Performance (Nov 16) and Employer Account Executive (Nov 4).
why_icp: Builds a national imaging network that connects payers, providers, and patients. Imaging is one of the most price-variable services, so negotiated-rate data is core to pitching employers and plans.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Partnerships or Manager, Reductions & Payor Performance
first_line: Saw you are hiring for payor performance and employer sales right after the $220M round.

signal: $20M Series A for AI that flags payer underpayments, missed rebates, and pricing errors for hospitals. Hiring a Value Engineer (Oct 21).
why_icp: Catching underpayments means checking what a payer should have paid. Contracted-rate benchmarks are a direct input.
first_line: Flagging payer underpayments gets a lot easier with outside benchmarks for what other payers pay for the same codes.

signal: $15M Series A. Largest network of independent NP-owned primary care practices; partnerships with Anthem, Cigna, Centene. Hiring Head of Payor Partnerships (Oct 13).
why_icp: Negotiates with payers on behalf of many small practices and is building an ACO. Knowing market rates is the first slide of every payer negotiation.
suggested_contact_title: Head of Payor Partnerships or CEO
first_line: Saw the Series A and the Head of Payor Partnerships opening. Rate benchmarks by market feel like day-one tools for that seat.

signal: $125M Series E (Morgan Health, Humana, CVS Health Ventures). Manages more than $7B in oncology spending. Hiring Senior Associate, Payer Growth Strategy and Operations (Oct 26).
why_icp: Value-based oncology contracts live or die on knowing what cancer care costs by payer and market.
suggested_contact_title: Payer Growth Strategy lead or Director, Partnership Operations
first_line: With more than $7B in oncology spend under management, payer-by-payer price data seems like a lever for the next contracts.

signal: $82M Series C. Works with health plans to arrange care at home. Hiring Health Plan Partnerships Lead (Nov 6).
why_icp: Selling into health plans means pricing against existing home-care rates. A plan-partnerships hire right after a raise is a live buying moment.
first_line: Saw the Series C and the new Health Plan Partnerships Lead role. Home-care rate benchmarks by plan could help that pitch.

signal: $30M raise to accelerate enterprise partnerships. Hiring a Payer Contracting Specialist (Oct 2).
why_icp: Virtual specialty provider actively contracting with payers; rate data shows where its contracts sit vs. the market.
first_line: Saw the Payer Contracting Specialist opening after the $30M raise. Market rate data could make those contract asks sharper.

signal: $40M Series A (FirstMark, CVS Health Ventures) for AI Medicare patient navigation. Open roles: RCM Lead and Head of Finance & Revenue Operations.
why_icp: Building revenue cycle from scratch for Medicare and Medicaid patients; rate data helps model reimbursement early.
first_line: Saw the $40M Series A and the RCM Lead opening. Early reimbursement modeling is where rate data helps most.

signal: $155M Series E (Francisco Partners). Employer-focused PBM alternative serving 45 Fortune 500 clients.
why_icp: Sells transparency to employers, the same buyer Serif serves on its Benefits & Workforce page. Medical-side rate data could extend its navigation product.
first_line: Saw the $155M Series E. Pharmacy pricing is transparent at Rightway now; curious if medical rates are next for the 45 Fortune 500 clients.

signal: $8M to build a utilization management platform shared by payers and providers.
why_icp: Early-stage and sits between payers and providers; a possible data partner more than a big buyer. Scored lower.
first_line: Saw the $8M launch. Pairing utilization decisions with what each payer actually pays for the service seems like a natural add.
